```{=html}
  }
  .e-row {

    gap: 16px;
  }
  #eSlider {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 48px;

    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #eSlider::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {

  }

<div class="sim-panel">
<div class="panel-title">🪐 Orbit Simulator</div>

  <canvas id="orbitCanvas" role="img" aria-label="Interactive Kepler orbit simulation showing an orbiting planet around the Sun"></canvas>

  <div class="controls">
    <p class="hint">Touch / drag the slider — watch the planet speed up near the Sun and slow down far away.</p>

    <div class="e-panel">
      <label class="e-label" for="eSlider">Eccentricity (e)</label>
      <div class="e-row">
        <input type="range" id="eSlider" min="0" max="0.85" step="0.01" value="0">
        <div class="e-readout" id="eReadout">0.000</div>
      </div>
      <div class="chips">
        <span class="chip">Perihelion <b id="periReadout">1.000 AU</b></span>
        <span class="chip">Aphelion <b id="aphReadout">1.000 AU</b></span>
        <span class="chip">Speed <b id="vReadout">1.00&times;</b></span>
        <span class="chip">Distance <b id="rReadout">1.000 AU</b></span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="buttons">
      <button id="pauseBtn" class="pause">⏸ Pause / Resume</button>
      <button class="preset" data-e="0">⭕ Circle (e = 0.00)</button>
      <button class="preset" data-e="0.017">🌍 Earth (e = 0.017)</button>
      <button class="preset" data-e="0.093">🔴 Mars (e = 0.093)</button>
      <button class="preset" data-e="0.967">☄️ Halley's Comet (e = 0.967)</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var canvas = document.getElementById("orbitCanvas");
  if (!canvas) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

  var slider = document.getElementById("eSlider");
  var readout = document.getElementById("eReadout");
  var pauseBtn = document.getElementById("pauseBtn");
  var vReadout = document.getElementById("vReadout");
  var rReadout = document.getElementById("rReadout");
  var periReadout = document.getElementById("periReadout");
  var aphReadout = document.getElementById("aphReadout");

  var e = 0.0;             // eccentricity
  var E = 0.0;             // eccentric anomaly (radians)
  var paused = false;
  var W = 800, H = 500;    // logical canvas size
  var BASE_RATE = 1.1;     // angular rate (rad/s) when r = a (circular orbit)

  function resize() {
    var w = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
    var h = canvas.clientHeight || 500;
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    W = w;
    H = h;
  }

  // Geometry for the current frame: ellipse centered at (cx, cy),
  // Sun (Focus 1) at the right focus, empty Focus 2 at the left focus.
  function geom() {
    var a = Math.min(W, H) * 0.30;         // semi-major axis (px); treated as 1 AU
    var b = a * Math.sqrt(1 - e * e);
    var c = a * e;
    var cx = W / 2;
    var cy = H / 2;
    var sunX = cx + c;
    var sunY = cy;
    var px = cx + a * Math.cos(E);
    var py = cy + b * Math.sin(E);
    var r = Math.hypot(px - sunX, py - sunY);
    var rAU = r / a;                       // normalized distance (a = 1 AU)
    var vRel = Math.pow(rAU, -1.2);        // Kepler's 2nd Law approximation: v ∝ r^-1.2
    return { a: a, b: b, c: c, cx: cx, cy: cy, sunX: sunX, sunY: sunY, px: px, py: py, r: r, rAU: rAU, vRel: vRel };
  }

  function draw() {
    var g = geom();
    var a = g.a, b = g.b, c = g.c, cx = g.cx, cy = g.cy;
    var sunX = g.sunX, sunY = g.sunY, px = g.px, py = g.py, rAU = g.rAU, vRel = g.vRel;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // major axis (guide line)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx - a, cy);
    ctx.lineTo(cx + a, cy);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25)";
    ctx.setLineDash([6, 8]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // orbit ellipse
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, a, b, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#38bdf8";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Focus 2 (empty marker)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx - c, cy, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#f472b6";
    ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Sun at Focus 1 (with glow)
    var grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sunX, sunY, 2, sunX, sunY, 34);
    grad.addColorStop(0, "#fff7d6");
    grad.addColorStop(0.35, "#fbbf24");
    grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(251, 191, 36, 0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 34, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sunX, sunY, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fde68a";
    ctx.fill();

    // radial vector: Sun -> planet
    var vgrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(sunX, sunY, px, py);
    vgrad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(253, 224, 71, 0.9)");
    vgrad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15)");
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sunX, sunY);
    ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    ctx.strokeStyle = vgrad;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // planet
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#4ade80";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#bbf7d0";
    ctx.stroke();

    // labels
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#e2e8f0";
    ctx.font = "700 18px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Sun (Focus 1)", sunX, sunY + 54);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f9a8d4";
    ctx.fillText("Focus 2 (empty)", cx - c, cy + 54);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#94a3b8";
    ctx.font = "600 16px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Perihelion (fastest)", cx + a, cy - 20);
    ctx.fillText("Aphelion (slowest)", cx - a, cy - 20);

    ctx.fillStyle = "#fef3c7";
    ctx.font = "700 16px 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif";
    var mx = (sunX + px) / 2;
    var my = (sunY + py) / 2;
    ctx.fillText(rAU.toFixed(2) + " AU", mx + 16, my - 10);

    // live readouts
    if (vReadout) vReadout.textContent = vRel.toFixed(2) + "\u00d7";
    if (rReadout) rReadout.textContent = rAU.toFixed(3) + " AU";
  }

  function updateActivePreset() {
    var buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".preset");
    for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
      var target = parseFloat(buttons[i].dataset.e);
      buttons[i].classList.toggle("active", Math.abs(target - e) < 0.0005);
    }
  }

  function setE(val) {
    e = Math.max(0, Math.min(val, 0.97));
    // Slider range is 0.00-0.85; extend only for Halley's Comet (0.967).
    slider.max = e > 0.85 ? 0.97 : 0.85;
    slider.value = Math.min(e, slider.max);
    if (readout) readout.textContent = e.toFixed(3);
    if (periReadout) periReadout.textContent = (1 - e).toFixed(3) + " AU";
    if (aphReadout) aphReadout.textContent = (1 + e).toFixed(3) + " AU";
    updateActivePreset();
  }

  if (slider) {
    slider.addEventListener("input", function () {
      e = parseFloat(slider.value);
      if (readout) readout.textContent = e.toFixed(3);
      if (periReadout) periReadout.textContent = (1 - e).toFixed(3) + " AU";
      if (aphReadout) aphReadout.textContent = (1 + e).toFixed(3) + " AU";
      updateActivePreset();
    });
  }

  var presets = document.querySelectorAll(".preset");
  for (var i = 0; i < presets.length; i++) {
    presets[i].addEventListener("click", function () {
      setE(parseFloat(this.dataset.e));
    });
  }

  if (pauseBtn) {
    pauseBtn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      paused = !paused;
      pauseBtn.textContent = paused ? "▶ Resume" : "⏸ Pause";
      pauseBtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!paused));
    });
  }

  var last = performance.now();
  function loop(ts) {
    var dt = Math.min((ts - last) / 1000, 0.05);
    last = ts;
    if (!paused) {
      var g = geom();
      E += BASE_RATE * dt * Math.pow(g.rAU, -1.2);
      if (E >= Math.PI * 2) E -= Math.PI * 2;
    }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  resize();
  setE(0.0);
  if (typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
    new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
```

## Data Comparison & Regents 5E Sensemaking {width="38%"}

::: {.card title="Planetary Orbital Parameters"}

| Planet | Semi-Major Axis $a$ (AU) | Eccentricity $e$ | Orbital Period (yr) |
|--------|--------------------------|------------------|---------------------|
| Mercury | 0.387 | 0.206 | 0.241 |
| Venus   | 0.723 | 0.007 | 0.615 |
| Earth   | 1.000 | 0.017 | 1.000 |
| Mars    | 1.524 | 0.093 | 1.881 |
| Jupiter | 5.203 | 0.048 | 11.862 |

:::: {.formula-box}
**NY Regents Eccentricity Formula**

$$e = \frac{d}{L}$$

$d$ = distance between foci &nbsp;·&nbsp; $L$ = length of the major axis
::::

:::
